response.justification: The candidate is a strong generalist engineer with deep web/backend experience (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), but does not meet the core requirements of this role. His C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis project — far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on C++ on Windows. He also has no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience (RIDE Capital was a Node/TypeScript fintech, not capital markets). SQL experience is generic (MySQL/MongoDB) rather than SQL Server/Oracle.
strengths: Solid low-latency/systems background (DLang, async I/O, high-throughput services)
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, pairing, DevOps tooling
Broad polyglot experience with Java, scripting, and messaging-adjacent architectures
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, roughly a decade ago
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain knowledge
No SQL Server/Oracle or Summit platform exposure; recent stack is entirely web-focused

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain background
Strong general engineering and performance fundamentals
